core: Lysosomal clearance of misfolded protein aggregates
qualifier: aggrephagy/aggresome plus chaperone-mediated and endosomal microautophagy routes
name: Aggregate and chaperone-mediated lysosomal protein clearance
rationale: All members concern routing misfolded or aggregated proteins to lysosomal degradation (aggrephagy, aggresome assembly with ataxin-3-type DUBs, CMA, late endosomal microautophagy), unlike ER quality control, general autophagosome maturation or organelle-selective autophagy in the confusables.

qualifier: branchiomotor cranial nerves and brainstem-controlled reflexes
name: Hindbrain development, branchiomotor nerves and brainstem reflexes
rationale: Members cover hindbrain/pons/brainstem development, neuronal migration and trigeminal/facial branchiomotor nerve formation plus brainstem-driven suckling and respiration, distinguishing them from spinal cord, cerebellar, olfactory/GnRH and locomotor-behaviour neighbours.

qualifier: catecholamine (adrenergic and dopamine) receptor control
name: Catecholamine-regulated adenylate cyclase-cAMP-PKA signaling
rationale: All members concern cAMP production, degradation and PKA/CREB/DARPP-32 output, with adrenergic and dopaminergic receptor regulation of the cyclase setting it apart from purinergic/muscarinic, LPA/PLC and smooth-muscle contraction neighbours.

qualifier: p14ARF loss and TP53 inactivation in cancer
name: p14ARF-p53-p21 G1 arrest axis and its cancer defects
rationale: Members describe p53 expression/co-factor regulation driving p21 and G1 arrest together with its cancer defects via p14ARF loss and TP53 tetramerization loss, distinguishing it from p53 phosphorylation/degradation, p53 apoptosis and p16INK4A-defect neighbours.

qualifier: leukotriene receptor signaling
name: Leukotriene and lipoxin biosynthesis, signaling and catabolism
rationale: All members concern 5-lipoxygenase-derived leukotrienes and lipoxins from synthesis through receptor signaling, transport and omega-oxidation catabolism, whereas confusables cover CYP eicosanoids, 12/15-HETE, hepoxilins or pro-resolving mediators without leukotriene receptor signaling.

qualifier: epoxygenase (EET) and omega-hydroxylase (20-HETE) branches
name: Cytochrome P450 epoxygenase and omega-hydroxylase eicosanoid synthesis
rationale: All members describe CYP-mediated epoxidation and omega-hydroxylation of arachidonic acid to EETs/DHETs and HETEs, distinguishing the theme from cyclooxygenase, leukotriene catabolism and generic CYP-substrate neighbours.

qualifier: endopeptidase activity regulation
name: Antigen-driven hypersensitivity with endopeptidase activity regulation
rationale: Most members concern antibody/antigen-driven type II and IV hypersensitivity, ADCC and acute inflammatory responses, and the theme is set apart from neutrophil degranulation, Fc receptor and complement neighbours by its positive and negative endopeptidase regulation members.

qualifier: 3'-end processing incl. histone mRNA, snRNP biogenesis and nuclear export
name: mRNA 3'-end processing, snRNP biogenesis and nuclear mRNA export
rationale: Members cover polyadenylation and histone stem-loop 3'-end processing, snRNP assembly/cap hypermethylation and export of mature mRNAs through the nuclear pore, distinguishing them from splice-site recognition, snRNA transcription and mRNA decay neighbours.

qualifier: at the Golgi in ER-Golgi traffic
name: Vesicle targeting and tethering in ER-Golgi traffic
rationale: All members are (obsolete) terms for vesicle targeting and tethering to or within the Golgi, whereas confusables concern COPI/COPII coat budding and cargo loading.

qualifier: pesticides, dioxin and endocrine-active compounds, AhR signaling
name: Response to pesticides, dioxins and endocrine-disrupting xenobiotics
rationale: Members are cellular responses to herbicides, insecticides, fungicides, TCDD, bisphenol A and genistein plus AhR signaling, distinguishing the theme from xenobiotic-metabolism, metal-ion and vitamin neighbours.

core: Sulfate and nucleotide-sugar donor supply for glycosaminoglycans
qualifier: arylsulfatase activation and hyaluronan degradation
name: Glycosaminoglycan donor supply, arylsulfatase activation and hyaluronan degradation
rationale: Members concern PAPS and UDP-sugar provision and transport (with their chondrodysplasia defects), arylsulfatase activation by oxidation and hyaluronan breakdown, distinguishing them from CDG transporter defects and GAG/glycosphingolipid synthesis or degradation neighbours.

qualifier: p14ARF/p16INK4A defects causing senescence evasion in cancer
name: p14ARF/p16INK4A-p53 tumor suppression and its cancer defects
rationale: Members cover p53-driven p21/G1 arrest and apoptosis together with cancer defects in p14ARF, p16INK4A and TP53 that evade senescence, distinguishing it from senescence programme, RB/CDK G1-S and p53 apoptotic-target neighbours.

qualifier: hematopoietic lineage and immune signaling target genes
name: RUNX1-centred transcription of hematopoietic and immune signaling genes
rationale: All members describe RUNX1 (with RUNX2/RUNX3) regulation and its control of myeloid, megakaryocyte, BCR and interleukin genes, unlike RUNX1 estrogen/WNT/keratinocyte or granulopoiesis neighbours.

qualifier: MYC-driven RNA polymerase I rRNA transcription and its chromatin control
name: MYC-driven ribosome biogenesis and rRNA gene transcription
rationale: Members cover Pol I rRNA transcription and its epigenetic regulation, rRNA processing, 5S transcription and MYC target programmes, distinguishing the theme from Pol III tRNA transcription and translation-initiation neighbours.

qualifier: both cAMP and PLC-IP3-calcium arms
name: G protein-coupled cAMP and IP3-calcium second-messenger generation
rationale: Members concern GPCR coupling to cyclic nucleotide production and to phospholipase C/IP3-calcium signaling, combining arms that confusables have only one of (cAMP-PKA downstream or Ca2+/phosphoinositide).

qualifier: caspase-cleaved PAK2 (PAK-2p34) regulation
name: Phosphoinositide-regulated serine kinase signaling including caspase-cleaved PAK2
rationale: Members link phosphoinositide/PTEN/AKT-TORC2 signaling with serine phosphorylation control, and the PAK-2p34 pathways and serine autophosphorylation distinguish the theme from PTEN/AKT and inositol pyrophosphate neighbours.

qualifier: cartilage development and homeostasis
name: Keratan sulfate metabolism and cartilage maintenance
rationale: Members cover keratan sulfate synthesis, degradation and enzyme defects plus cartilage-linked chondrodysplasias and cartilage homeostasis, distinguishing it from CS/DS/HS GAG and dystroglycan glycosylation neighbours.

qualifier: osteoclast regulation and mineralization balance
name: Osteoblast-osteoclast coupling in bone remodeling and mineralization
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast and osteoclast differentiation, bone resorption and mineralization with Wnt/TGF-beta/BMP and mesenchymal stromal inputs, whereas confusables focus on ossification, chondrocyte and tendon development without the osteoclast arm.

qualifier: leptin/ghrelin hormonal control and nutrient-level responses
name: Regulation of appetite, feeding behavior and nutrient-level responses
rationale: Members concern eating behavior, appetite and responses to food and nutrient levels including leptin and ghrelin, distinguishing them from growth, sleep/orexin and gut/calcitonin-family receptor neighbours.

qualifier: intestinal/renal epithelial SLC2/SLC5 transporters and their inherited defects
name: Epithelial hexose transport and its inherited defects
rationale: All members concern glucose, galactose and fructose transport by GLUT/SGLT carriers in intestine and kidney and their disease defects, unlike urate, amino acid, galactose catabolism or digestion neighbours.

qualifier: misfolded protein quality control, ERAD and degron rules
name: Ubiquitin-dependent quality-control degradation of misfolded proteins
rationale: Members cover misfolded protein responses, ERAD regulation, N/C-end degron and proteasomal degradation control with DUBs and E3s, distinguishing it from ubiquitin chain-type, ribosome quality control and aggrephagy neighbours.

qualifier: hair follicle cycling, nail and melanocyte development
name: Hair follicle, skin appendage and melanocyte development
rationale: Members cover hair follicle development and anagen, sebaceous gland and nail development, melanocyte proliferation/differentiation and epidermal morphogenesis, distinguishing them from cornification/keratinocyte and ectodermal placode neighbours.

qualifier: excitatory (PSD-95/NMDA receptor) membrane assembly
name: Trans-synaptic adhesion-driven excitatory synapse membrane assembly
rationale: Members concern neurexin/neuroligin, SALM and receptor PTP adhesion organizing pre- and postsynaptic membranes with PSD-95 and NMDA receptor clustering, distinguishing them from inhibitory/GABA synapse and synaptic potential neighbours.

qualifier: activity-dependent spine actin remodeling and dendrite arborization
name: Activity-dependent postsynaptic remodeling, spine plasticity and dendrite arborization
rationale: Members regulate dendritic spine and postsynaptic actin remodeling, NMDAR-RAC1 signaling, synaptic plasticity/LTD and dendrite branching, unlike RHO/EPHB, BDNF-TRK or reelin spine-maintenance neighbours.

qualifier: amyloid-beta clearance
name: Microglial activation and clearance of amyloid-beta and apoptotic cells
rationale: Members cover microglial activation, migration, proliferation and cytotoxicity with apoptotic-cell and amyloid-beta clearance, the amyloid-beta clearance setting it apart from efferocytosis and DAP12 neighbours and the microglial terms from amyloid fibril neighbours.
